svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Lattice Join
svg.desc: Policy layers fold in a fixed order through the lattice join; repository control overrides apply after the join.
